gates.requiredScope: Record an expected failing guard for CS1591 suppression, the same guard passing after remediation, and full regression evidence; unrelated failures do not count as red.
All four product projects generate XML documentation, no project or global NoWarn contains 1591, and every externally public API has complete applicable XML elements.
exactCommands: pwsh -NoProfile -Command '$projects = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath src -Recurse -Filter *.csproj); if ($projects.Count -ne 4) { throw "Expected four product projects" }; foreach ($project in $projects) { $xml = [xml](Get-Content -LiteralPath $project.FullName -Raw -Encoding UTF8); $doc = @($xml.Project.PropertyGroup.GenerateDocumentationFile) -contains "true"; $noWarn = (@($xml.Project.PropertyGroup.NoWarn) -join ";"); if (-not $doc -or $noWarn -match "(^|;)\s*1591\s*(;|$)") { throw "XML documentation gate failed: $($project.FullName)" } }'

gates.requiredScope: Serve generated DocFX only on loopback and obtain zero axe violations on the index, Pl0Compiler, and VirtualMachine pages with the pinned temporary audit harness.
exactCommands: audit_dir="$(mktemp -d)"; printf 'audit_dir=%s\n' "$audit_dir"; npm --prefix "$audit_dir" init -y; npm --prefix "$audit_dir" install --save-exact --ignore-scripts @playwright/test@1.62.1 @axe-core/playwright@4.13.0; npm --prefix "$audit_dir" exec playwright install chromium; (cd "$audit_dir" && node --input-type=module --eval 'import { chromium } from "playwright"; import AxeBuilder from "@axe-core/playwright"; const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true }); const urls = ["http://127.0.0.1:8080/index.html", "http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/Pl0.Core.Pl0Compiler.html", "http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/Pl0.Vm.VirtualMachine.html"]; let failed = false; for (const url of urls) { const page = await browser.newPage(); await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: "networkidle" }); const result = await new AxeBuilder({ page }).analyze(); console.log(JSON.stringify({ url, violations: result.violations.map(v => ({ id: v.id, impact: v.impact, nodes: v.nodes.length })) })); failed ||= result.violations.length > 0; await page.close(); } await browser.close(); if (failed) process.exit(1);')
